users.description: Ben covers tech, AI, online safety and anything with a battery.
Daniel covers the NRL and A-League.
Emma runs the national desk from Sydney and has covered state politics for 14 years.
Grace writes about health, food and the way Australians actually live.
Hannah is a weekend producer on the homepage team.
Jack covers crime and the courts in Melbourne.
Marcus programs the news.com.au homepage on weekday mornings.
Mia covers celebrity, TV and film. She has interviewed half of Hollywood and the cast of every reality show you have watched.
Olivia covers the economy, property and personal finance.
Priya edits the world desk and spent five years as a correspondent in Jakarta.
Sam has visited 70 countries and still thinks Tasmania is the best of them.
Tom has covered four Olympics, three Ashes series and more grand finals than he can count.
